outcome_statement: Implement the engines and data schemas defined in `docs/products/builderos/specs/CONSTITUTIONAL_LEARNING_ARCHITECTURE.md` so Taloa can continuously improve its understanding through reality. Each engine is a service under `services/` with an `@ssot` JSDoc tag, a `Mission Contribution` field, and a minimal smoke test. The Human Constellation becomes the canonical person model that all OS products project. No office becomes the source of truth; every engine is calibrated by reality.
